component.description: LQW18AN_00 series 10 nH high-frequency wirewound RF chip inductor (0603 / 1608-metric) for consumer/industrial equipment. A DIVERSE sibling to the WE-LHMI power-inductor exemplar: this RF chip inductor is characterized by the parameters a power inductor never carries - a guaranteed minimum quality factor Q (measured at a spot RF frequency, 250 MHz for this value), a self-resonant frequency SRF, and a single combined rated_current (not the split saturation/heating pair), with inductance measured at 100 MHz rather than 100 kHz. Non-polarized 2-terminal part (functions A/B). Row for the 10 nH, tolerance-code-G (+/-2%) grade extracted from the series rating table.

measurements.conditionsVerbatim: Nominal inductance 10 nH; measuring frequency 100 MHz (per §7.1, Keysight E4991A or equivalent, approx. 0 dBm signal)
Tolerance code G = +/-2% (the G grade of the 10 nH part; a J grade with +/-5% is also offered)
Q min. 35; measuring frequency 250 MHz (the 2.2 nH-39 nH Q band per §7.1); measured with Keysight E4991A or equivalent
Self-resonant frequency 6000 MHz min.; measured with Keysight N5230A or equivalent (§7.4)
DC resistance 0.11 ohm max.; measured with a digital multimeter (§7.3)

Rated current 650 mA - a single combined figure defined by product temperature rise 20 degC max. AND inductance change rate within +/-10% (§7.5); an RF chip inductor gives one rating rather than splitting into distinct saturation and heating limits
Operating temperature range -55 degC to +125 degC (storage temperature range identical)
